styles.name: stickman

backgrounds.name: abstract

backgrounds.name: forest
backgrounds.summary: Layered woodland: misty hills, rows of trees, a winding path with grass, rocks, mushrooms and flowers; spring / summer / autumn / winter, with light shafts and fireflies

params.name: time_of_day
params.description: lighting and sky

params.name: mood
params.description: colour mood

params.name: density
params.description: how much set-dressing / clutter (0 sparse .. 1 busy)

params.name: season
params.description: spring = fresh greens, pink blossom, petals; summer = lush green and wildflowers; autumn = orange/red/gold leaves, mushrooms and falling leaves; winter = bare trees, snow-capped pines, snowy ground and falling snow

params.name: trees
params.description: broadleaf = round leafy trees (and birches); pine = tall evergreen conifers; mixed = both. In winter the broadleaf trees are bare.

params.name: fog
params.description: mist between the tree rows: 0 = crystal clear, 0.3 = soft haze, 1 = thick fog

params.name: path
params.description: true = a winding dirt path leads into the woods; false = open grassy clearing

backgrounds.name: rooftop
backgrounds.summary: City rooftop with a layered skyline (dense towers, low-rise town or harbor), parapet, water tower, string lights and rooftop clutter; best at dusk or night

params.name: time_of_day
params.description: lighting and sky

params.name: mood
params.description: colour mood

params.name: density
params.description: how much set-dressing / clutter (0 sparse .. 1 busy)

params.name: skyline
params.description: dense = tall downtown towers packed together; sparse = a low-rise town with pitched roofs, hills and a church spire; harbor = waterfront with a bay, a bridge on the horizon, cranes and boats

params.name: lights
params.description: string (festoon) lights strung overhead; they glow at dusk, dawn and night

params.name: railing
params.description: a metal safety railing on top of the parapet wall (false = bare parapet)

backgrounds.name: room
backgrounds.summary: Interior set (bedroom, living room, office or kitchen) with a window onto the sky, lit lamps/screens at dusk and night, rugs, shelves, plants and a door. Slots: 'door' (left edge), 'window' (right); 'sofa'/'bed'/'desk'/'counter' all stand in front of the room's main piece of furniture on the right

params.name: time_of_day
params.description: lighting and sky

params.name: mood
params.description: colour mood

params.name: density
params.description: how much set-dressing / clutter (0 sparse .. 1 busy)

params.name: room
params.description: which room: bedroom (bed, nightstand lamp, fairy lights), living (sofa, floor lamp, gallery wall), office (desk, monitor, pinboard, blinds) or kitchen (counter, fridge, hanging lamp)

params.name: view
params.description: what shows through the window: plain sky with clouds/sun/moon, a city skyline, or a garden with hills and trees

params.name: lights
params.description: lamps and screens: auto = switched on at dawn/dusk/night, on = always lit (e.g. a cosy day scene), off = dark (lights-out moment)

backgrounds.name: stage
backgrounds.summary: Studio / theatre stage for titles and punchlines: curtains, studio or city backdrop (or a confetti party), polished floor with pulsing spotlights, optional podium and sparkles. Slots: 'spot_left'/'spot_right' stand in the beams, 'podium' behind the lectern, 'apron' down-stage

params.name: time_of_day
params.description: lighting and sky

params.name: mood
params.description: colour mood

params.name: density
params.description: how much set-dressing / clutter (0 sparse .. 1 busy)

params.name: backdrop
params.description: what hangs behind the performers: curtain (red velvet theatre curtains with a valance), spotlight (dark TV studio with LED pylons and a light rig), city_lights (night-club skyline with bokeh lights) or confetti (party: bunting, balloons, streamers, falling confetti)

params.name: beams
params.description: number of spotlight beams / pools of light on the floor (0 = evenly lit; 2 lights the 'left' and 'right' positions, 1 the centre)

params.name: podium
params.description: a lectern with a microphone in front of the centre position: a character at 'center'/'podium' appears behind it (legs hidden); false = open stage

params.name: sparkles
params.description: glitter drifting in the spotlight beams; falling confetti is added when the mood is 'playful' or the backdrop is 'confetti'

backgrounds.name: street
backgrounds.summary: Charming city street: layered skyline, shopfront buildings, lamp posts, sidewalk and road; downtown / suburb / market districts in clear, rain, snow or fog

params.name: time_of_day
params.description: lighting and sky

params.name: mood
params.description: colour mood

params.name: density
params.description: how much set-dressing / clutter (0 sparse .. 1 busy)

params.name: weather
params.description: clear = open sky; rain = overcast, wet ground and falling rain; snow = white ground and falling snow; fog = thick mist that fades the distance

params.name: district
params.description: downtown = tall shopfront buildings, cars and a traffic light; suburb = houses with lawns, hedges and picket fences; market = old-town square with colourful stalls, bunting and cobblestones

params.name: shops
params.description: true = ground floors are shopfronts with awnings and signs (a corner store in the suburb); false = plain residential doors, stoops and porches

backgrounds.name: whiteboard
backgrounds.summary: Explainer set: a clean whiteboard filling the frame with hand-drawn marker doodles (bulb, chart, arrows, stars) and a marker-tray ledge for characters to stand on (slots tray_left / tray_center / tray_right); the base for the stick-figure / marker style

params.name: time_of_day
params.description: lighting and sky

params.name: mood
params.description: colour mood

params.name: density
params.description: how much set-dressing / clutter (0 sparse .. 1 busy)

params.name: grid
params.description: faint pattern printed on the board: dots (dot grid), lines (graph-paper squares) or none (blank board)

params.name: doodles
params.description: theme of the hand-drawn marker doodles in the margins: ideas (lightbulb, chart, arrows, stars, underline), business (coins, rising chart, target), science (atom, flask, gear) or none

params.name: marker
params.description: marker colours of the doodles: multi (several bright colours), black or blue (one ink)

params.name: tray
params.description: show the aluminium marker tray (with markers and an eraser) as the ledge the characters stand on; false = just a hand-drawn ground line on the board

actions.name: cry
actions.summary: Tears, trembling shoulders and a hand wiping the eye

params.name: style
params.description: sob=hand to eye, weep=both hands, bawl=open-mouthed wailing

params.name: intensity
params.description: how hard they cry

actions.name: enter_from
actions.summary: Enter the frame from an edge (or drop in from above) and arrive at the layer's position

params.name: side
params.description: which edge to come in from (auto = nearest to the destination)

params.name: to
params.description: where to end up (default: the layer's position)

params.name: style
params.description: walk/run in from the edge, slide in gliding, or drop in from above with a bounce

actions.name: exit_to
actions.summary: Leave the frame through an edge

params.name: side
params.description: edge to leave through (auto = nearest)

params.name: style
params.description: how the character leaves

actions.name: fall
actions.summary: Slip, trip or faint: flail, hit the ground with a bounce, lie there (optionally get up)

params.name: kind
params.description: pratfall type

params.name: get_up
params.description: stand back up at the end instead of staying down

params.name: dizzy
params.description: swirly eyes while down

actions.name: idle
actions.summary: Stand and breathe; `mood` shades the body language (bored, nervous, happy, ...)

params.name: mood
params.description: body language to hold

params.name: intensity
params.description: how pronounced the mood is

actions.name: jump
actions.summary: Crouch (anticipation), leap, land with squash and settle

params.name: height
params.description: peak height as a fraction of the character's height

params.name: dx
params.description: drift forward during the jump, in frame widths

params.name: style
params.description: normal=arms swing up, cheer=both arms overhead, tuck=knees to chest, star=star jump

actions.name: laugh
actions.summary: Squinting, shaking laugh: chuckle, belly laugh or cackle

params.name: style
params.description: chuckle=small, belly=hand on stomach, cackle=head back

params.name: intensity
params.description: how hard they laugh

actions.name: look_at
actions.summary: Turn head and eyes towards a target (camera, direction, slot or character)

params.name: target
params.description: 'camera', 'up'/'down'/'left'/'right', [x,y], a slot or a character id

params.name: eyes_only
params.description: move only the eyes, keep the head still

params.name: turn
params.description: turn the body round if the target is behind

actions.name: pick_up
actions.summary: Crouch, grab an item from the floor (a prop the character owns) and stand up with it

params.name: prop
params.description: name of a prop the character owns; it ends up in their hand

params.name: side
params.description: which hand grabs (auto = the prop's usual hand)

actions.name: point
actions.summary: Extend an arm and point at a direction, slot or character

params.name: direction
params.description: screen direction to point (ignored when `target` is set)

params.name: target
params.description: point at: [x,y], a slot name, or a character id

params.name: hand
params.description: which arm points (auto = the right arm unless it is holding a prop)

params.name: jabs
params.description: emphatic jabs while pointing

params.name: turn
params.description: turn to face the pointing direction

actions.name: run
actions.summary: Run to a point or slot; sprint, jog or panic

params.name: to
params.description: Destination: [x,y], a slot name or a character id

params.name: style
params.description: jog=relaxed, sprint=all-out, panic=flailing arms, wide eyes, sweat

params.name: in_place
params.description: run on the spot (the camera or background moves instead)

actions.name: surprise
actions.summary: Jolt, recoil with wide eyes and an exclamation burst, then a comedic hold

params.name: intensity
params.description: how big the jolt is

params.name: hold
params.description: comedic freeze at the peak, in seconds (default ~45% of the action)

actions.name: talk
actions.summary: Lip-flap in syllable rhythm with head nods, brow flicks and small gestures

params.name: text
params.description: what is said (sets the syllable rhythm of the mouth)

params.name: words
params.description: word timings [t0, t1, word] relative to the action start (filled in from TTS alignment)

params.name: energy
params.description: speech animation intensity

params.name: gestures
params.description: add small hand/arm gestures while talking

actions.name: think
actions.summary: Hand to chin, eyes up, thought bubble; optional 'aha!' ending

params.name: style
params.description: hand to chin, scratching the head, or finger on lips

params.name: aha
params.description: finish with a light-bulb moment (finger up, wide eyes, burst)

actions.name: walk
actions.summary: Walk to a point or slot (or on the spot); gait style via `style`

params.name: to
params.description: Destination: [x,y] screen fractions, a slot name or a character id

params.name: dx
params.description: Relative move in frame widths (+ right) when `to` is not set

params.name: dy
params.description: Relative move in frame heights (+ down)

params.name: style
params.description: gait: sneak=crouched and slow, tired=slumped shuffle, happy=bouncy, stomp=angry, march=stiff, strut=swaggering

params.name: in_place
params.description: walk on the spot (the camera or background moves instead)

actions.name: wave
actions.summary: Raise a hand beside the head and wave hello

params.name: hand
params.description: which hand waves (auto = the right hand unless it is holding a prop)

params.name: speed
params.description: wave tempo multiplier

params.name: energy
params.description: how big the wave is

transitions.name: crossfade
transitions.summary: Dissolve from one scene into the next

params.name: curve
params.description: easing of the dissolve

transitions.name: cut
transitions.summary: Hard cut: the next scene starts immediately

transitions.name: page_flip
transitions.summary: The outgoing page curls away like a turning page, revealing the next scene

params.name: direction
params.description: the page peels towards this side

params.name: radius
params.description: curl radius as a fraction of the frame width

transitions.name: wipe
transitions.summary: A soft-edged line sweeps across the frame revealing the next scene

params.name: direction
params.description: direction the wipe edge travels

params.name: softness
params.description: width of the soft edge as a fraction of the frame

params.name: angle
params.description: tilt of the wipe edge in degrees

camera_moves.name: dolly
camera_moves.summary: Push in/out with real parallax (near layers grow faster)

camera_moves.name: pan
camera_moves.summary: Slide the camera across the set (parallax: far layers move less)
camera_moves.from_to: [x, y] camera offsets in frame fractions: a small drift, e.g. [0, 0] -> [0.06, 0] (x within +-0.25, y within +-0.10); NOT screen positions

camera_moves.name: rack_focus
camera_moves.summary: Shift focus between depth layers (blurs the others)

camera_moves.name: shake
camera_moves.summary: Handheld shake; also use for impacts

caption_styles.name: shout
caption_styles.summary: Huge slam-in text with a camera-shake feel, for punchlines; sits above the characters' heads

caption_styles.name: subtitle
caption_styles.summary: Reading text on the ground line, inside the bottom safe margin; words pop in, the spoken word is highlighted

caption_styles.name: title
caption_styles.summary: Large headline in the upper third; letters drop in with a bounce
